entries.title: Psalms 36:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. [The oracle] utters transgression to the wicked within my heart. [There is] no fear of God before his eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 36:2
segments: For he flatters himself in his own eyes in order to find his iniquity, to hate [it].

entries.title: Psalms 36:3
segments: The words of his mouth [are] evil and deceit; he has stopped acting wise and doing good.

entries.title: Psalms 36:4
segments: He plots evil on his bed; he sets himself in a way [that is] not good; he does not hate evil.

entries.title: Psalms 36:5
segments: Your mercy, O LORD, [is] in the heavens; Your faithfulness [reaches] to the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 36:6
segments: Your righteousness [is] like the great mountains; Your judgments [are] a great deep; O LORD, You keep man and beast.

entries.title: Psalms 36:7
segments: How precious [is] Your loving-kindness, O God! And the sons of men take refuge under the shadow of Your wing.

entries.title: Psalms 36:8
segments: They shall be satisfied with the fatness of Your house; and You shall make them drink of the river of Your pleasures.

entries.title: Psalms 36:9
segments: For with You [is] the fountain of life; in Your light we shall see light.

entries.title: Psalms 36:10
segments: O continue Your loving-kindness to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 36:11
segments: Do not let the foot of pride come against me, and do not let the hand of the wicked move me.

entries.title: Psalms 36:12
segments: There the evil-doers have fallen; they are cast down, and cannot rise.
